title: Round 12: the Desert Cup's set pieces

items.title: Gulch: the stamp mill
items.text: Rebuilt taller and moved to the outside of the hairpin, so the chase camera meets it on the way in.
ask: Does it read as a mill at racing speed?

items.title: Sidewinder: the oil field from the race
items.text: Pump jacks now nod; the field sits on the long left-hander.
